title: Privacy policy
meta_description: How Artificia Intellec Pvt Ltd collects, uses, keeps and deletes your personal data, in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

fields.body:
Artificia Intellec Pvt Ltd ("Artificia", "we") runs artificiaai.com. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

We handle personal data in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (the DPDP Act).

What we collect

When you send a form, we collect what you type: your name, phone or WhatsApp number and email, and details such as your company, city or message.

With it we record the page you were on, the link or ad that brought you, the time, your IP address and your browser type.

Why we collect it

We use your details to reply to your enquiry and to talk with you about the course, training or service you asked about.

We use the page and ad details to learn which of our pages and ads work.

Your consent

Every form asks for your consent before you send it. You can withdraw consent at any time by emailing info@artificiaai.com.

How we contact you

We reply by WhatsApp, phone or email, using the details you gave us. We do not sell or rent your personal data.

Who else handles it

  • Our hosting provider stores this website and its database.
  • Our team receives each enquiry by email and in the tools we use to manage enquiries.
  • If a Facebook or Instagram ad brought you here, we tell Meta an enquiry arrived, so it can measure the ad. We scramble (hash) your email and phone first.

Cookies and analytics

We use Google Analytics 4 to count visits, and the Meta pixel to measure our ads. Both use cookies. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiry details only for as long as we need them to answer you and follow up. After that, we delete them.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your personal data, or withdraw your consent. Email info@artificiaai.com and tell us what you would like us to do.

If you are not satisfied with our reply, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

Contact

Email info@artificiaai.com, phone +91 91044 88859.

Last updated 27 October 2026.
